Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno; molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind = 4; mesh_heading contains 'lymphoma' (case-insensitive). Sort: chembl_id ascending, pref_name ascending, canonical_smiles ascending, indication_curie ascending, indication_label ascending, max_phase_for_ind ascending.
